Markerlight: During each Reinforcement phase, place a number of Markerlight tokens next to each unit equal to the number of "Markerlight“ shots they have. These Markerlight tokens can be assigned to enemy units that are targeted by the activated unit. Friendly units that are in range and line of sight of the target may assign their Markerlight tokens to it as well during the same activation. A unit’s own Markerlight tokens have to be used up first before it may make use of Markerlight tokens from a friendly unit. Can not be assigned if the unit is locked in melee combat.

Markerlight tokens can be spent to gain a number of benefits (see table).

# Token/Cost - Effect
1 - Re-roll a single wound roll.
1 - One Seeker missile equipped by the unit may automatically hit the target.
1 - Reduce the enemy Leadership by a cumulative 1 until the end of the battle round.
2 - Attacks gain the cumulative "Sunder(1)" ability.
2 - Reduce the to hit penalty for Defensive Fire by 1.
2 - Re-roll ranged to hit rolls of 1 .
2 - Re-roll a single armor penetration roll.
3 - The target must pass a Leadership test or gain a Battleshock token.
3 - The target is hit by a Seeker missile (see Armory) from outside the battlefield. Vehicles are hit on the side the unit would normally be able to hit.

Example: A unit that wants to re-roll ranged to hit rolls of 1 and reduce the cover bonus for the enemy by 1 must remove a total of 4 tokens from the target unit.

Each token can only be used for a single effect from the table and all unused tokens are discarded at the end of the battle round. An enemy unit may not have more than 4 Markerlight tokens on it at the same time.

Supporting Fire: If a friendly unit within 6" is the target of a charge and is using Defensive Fire, this unit may be activated in the same way to use Defensive fire at the charging enemy. Note that this is only doable with an unused order token and will use up that same token.
